thread:
rahul.api: Heads-up — target change window tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC for cross-service rollout. Components: runtime v3.2.0 (KV cache + perf), api v1.14.0, router sticky-session toggle, and console minor UI change. Need pin decisions, canary plan, and rollback playbook.

anya.product: Thanks — will the console change require DB migration? if yes we need a docs blurb and release notes.

jin.eng-runtime: No DB migration. Runtime change is KV cache layout and a config flag for legacy compatibility. It's designed to be backwards-compatible for api v1.13.x but we should pin the api to v1.14.0 for the perf path.

sam.dev: Canary proposal: 1% -> 10% -> 50% over 45m per region, hold 10m between ramps. Circuit breaker thresholds: 5xx spike > 1% or p95 latency +30% -> pause and rollback. Sound ok?

morgan.sre: Change window approved. Reminder: maintenance page for affected customers and page on-call list. Rollback plan should include: pinned fallback images for runtime + api, router sticky toggle fallback, and global-region failover. Keep global swap blocked until canary green.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: canary -> us-west1 @ 1763510200. Tags: runtime:v3.2.0, api:v1.14.0, router:sticky-2026-03-18, console:v0.9.8. Canary policy: 1% traffic baseline.

rahul.api: Confirming: pin console to v0.9.8 until runtime canary completes. We should also publish short release notes highlighting api contract change (header X-RT-VERSION).

console-ux: Ack — will hold console release flag and push release notes doc to /releases/notes by EOD.

jin.eng-runtime: Quick pin command (run on infra-tooling):

```
pin-version --service api --version 1.14.0 --compat runtime:3.2.0
pin-version --service console --version 0.9.8
```

Rollback command (if canary fails):

```
rollback-deploy --service runtime --to-tag runtime:v3.1.7 --reason "canary-failure"
rollback-deploy --service api --to-tag api:v1.13.9
router-toggle --set sticky=false --region us-west1
```

sam.dev: +1 on the commands. Who's owning monitoring dashboard during ramp?

morgan.sre: I'll own SLO dashboards and on-call runway. Create an eval job that hits the canary path for end-to-end smoke. If errors >2% for 5m we trigger rollback.

anya.product: Release notes checklist: 1) user-visible header change, 2) potential minor schema difference in rerank endpoint, 3) recommended client pin. I'll draft.

rahul.api: One more requirement — router change should be applied as region-local toggle first. No global promotion until dual-region canary green. Jin, can you split router change into two flags?

jin.eng-runtime: Yes — router supports router:sticky-local and router:sticky-global flags. We'll apply sticky-local in canary.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for us-west1 @ 1763510200. Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/1763510200 (1% traffic).

sam.dev: Smoke: ran basic generate + embed tests against canary. p95 latency up 8ms, no 5xx. ramp to 10%.

morgan.sre: Observability note: watch KV cache miss rate and eviction churn metrics (kc.miss_rate, kc.evictions). Set alert at miss_rate > 2% sustained.

jin.eng-runtime: Added runtime metric gating: if kc.evictions spike -> automatic reduce batch size and notify.

deploy-bot: Canary ramped to 10% -> 50% per schedule @ 1763512000.

rahul.api: Proceeding to pin versions in deployment manifest and publish preliminary release notes. If any team requests hold, say now.

console-ux: Holding console release flag is done. Release notes link: https://confluence.internal/releases/cross-service-1763509876

anya.product: :thumbsup: posted checklist and will join post-mortem/notes channel for results.

sam.dev: All green on canary services in us-west1. Recommend promoting sticky-local to additional region us-east1 as next step, still no global.

morgan.sre: Agreed. If issues surface we follow the rollback commands. On-call ready.

rahul.api: Final: no global router flip until 24h of stable metrics. Closing the coordination thread, thanks everyone. :tada:
